Manage crypto wallets and make x402 micropayments with USDC stablecoins on Polygon

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with crypto wallet and x402 micropayment support.

Features:
- Create & manage HD wallets with encryption
- Check USDC balance on Polygon testnet/mainnet
- Set spending limits (per-transaction & daily)
- Make x402 micropayments to paid APIs
- Register paid APIs as reusable tools
- Transaction history tracking
- Seller tools for payment verification

Default network: Polygon Amoy testnet (safe for testing)
